title: What is actually built in the lab?
prompt: Pick the accurate description of the lab deliverable.

options.text: A custom integration, built hands-on, after covering actions, MCP, and Client API integrations.
options.feedback: Correct. The published agenda ends with a hands-on workshop to build a custom integration.

options.text: A slide deck describing a proposed integration.
options.feedback: No. The workshop is a build session, not a design review.

options.text: A custom connector for a proprietary data source.
options.feedback: No. Custom connectors are a separate course with its own lab environment.
